Gold Prices Fluctuate Ahead of September 21, 2026

Gold prices are showing fluctuations with immediate support levels identified at Rs 152,000 and resistance at Rs 155,000, with further resistance seen at Rs 158,300 and Rs 160,000-160,300. The outlook for the week of September 21, 2026, indicates potential price movements. Latest rates for 24K, 22K, and 18K gold are available for cities including Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata, with reports noting a fall in prices on September 21, 2026.
